title: The Canon of the Hooked Disarm
summary: Sets out taking a sword from the hand with the hooked bend for Champions and veteran soldiers.

title: A Treatise on Answering Hook with Hook
summary: Teaches how to meet an enemy hook sword and turn its pull back on the wielder.

title: The Pull That Opens the Guard
summary: Shows how steady pulls with the hooked guard open a defender's cover for the thrust that follows.

title: Advanced Course on the Bound Blade
summary: An advanced course on holding a bound sword and fighting with the free hand and foot.

title: Twin Hooks of the Azure Basin
summary: Teaches fighting with two hook swords in paired circles that close like a basin around the foe.

title: The Paired Hook Court Treatise
summary: A treatise on matched hooks in a court pair for students trained to move as two arms.

title: River-Bend Hook Method
summary: Teaches yielding like a river around a bend then hooking and throwing the foe past the turn.

title: Hawk-Claw Hook Canon
summary: A canon of the hawk's stoop and talon applied to the hook sword for Rulers.

title: Wind-Sworn Hook Forms
summary: Forms of the hook sword sworn to the wind and meant for open ground and quick footwork.

title: The Plateau Edge Hook Book
summary: Teaches fighting at the edge of reach with hooks that pull a foe off balance.

title: Oath of the Bearing Hook
summary: Binds the student to one bearing and one hooked line held through bind and cut.

title: Gale-Hook Cuts Without Walls
summary: Teaches whirling and sweeping hook cuts that clear a ring in open ground against many foes.
